name: Ukiki Saruyoshi
source: Brave, crude, fearless and strongest leader of all-boys school full of delinquents. While enjoying his youth of fighting and fooling around with his male comrades everyday, he finds out that his school will soon close down to build a parking lot due to financial problem. To save the precious place full of memories with his friends, he comes in contact with the daughter of a huge enterprise which is the biggest supporter of Garasunomiya all-girls school to suggest schools merging. However, he never dreamed of the condition the refined ojousama would give him in return...
